candidates.title: LDD completion record: Petersham
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive records Petersham in Richmond upon Thames as Completed on 2017-08-31. The row records 2576 sqm proposed floorspace; 2.504 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Proposal for the co-location of Strathmore and Russell Schools onto a single site in purpose built facilities with associated car parking and landscaping. The Proposed Development involves the construction of a new purpose built school to house the existing Russell Primary School with an expanded size from its existing one form entry (FE) provision, to a one FE plus a shared FE (an additional four classrooms). The existing nursery on the Russell School site would also be accommodated in the new school building.

candidates.title: LDD completion record: Kings Reach Tower, Stamford Street
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive records Kings Reach Tower, Stamford Street in Southwark as Completed on 2016-07-06. The row records 175 proposed homes; 3701 sqm proposed floorspace; 1.127 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Refurbishment and re-cladding of the tower and podium buildings, erection of six additional storeys to the tower for residential use [132.2m AOD to top of core] and change of use of floors 11 to 30 of the tower from offices to residential [to provide a total of 173 flats]; erection of a series of extensions and additions for office use including the erection of a ten storey infill atrium building between the tower and T shaped podium, erection of a part one, part three storey roof extension to the podium building and a series of other extensions to the north, east and west of the podium building to accommodate plant and stair cores. Creation of retail (Class A1, A2, A3 and A4) space, pool and gym (Class D2) on the ground floor, provision of new and refurbished landscaping, plant and equipment, formation of new accesses, including formation of a new pedestrian route linking Stamford Street to Upper Ground, and public realm improvements.

candidates.title: LDD completion record: Site Bounded By, Liverpool Road
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive records Site Bounded By, Liverpool Road in Islington as Completed on 2008-08-01. The row records 11380 sqm proposed floorspace; 1.2 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Erection of a new school for 5-18 year olds and an Early Years Centre. The school is to accommodate approximately 1150 secondary students and 210 primary and infants, with associated playgrounds and landscaping. The scheme would involve demolition of the existing buildings on the site, and selected felling of existing trees. The scheme would comprise the main entrance to the secondary school on Liverpool Road with a new building on this frontage having a height of 14.5 metres above basement plus roof top multi-use games area with enclosure. Buildings fronting Bride Street are part 3 and part 4 storeys with the building on the Lough Road frontage of 2 storeys above basement. The entrance to the Early Years Centre is provided on Bride Street and the entrance to the Primary School is on Lough Road.

The scheme would comprise the main entrance to the secondary school on Liverpool Road with a new building on this frontage having a height of 14.5 metres above basement plus roof top multi-use games area with enclosure. Buildings fronting Bride Street are part 3 and part 4 storeys with the building on the Lough Road frontage of 2 storeys above basement. The entrance to the Early Years Centre is provided on Bride Street and the entrance to the Primary School is on Lough Road.

The row records 29285 sqm proposed floorspace; 0.278 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Erection of a new building on basement, lower ground, lower ground mezzanine, ground and eight upper floors for office use (Class B1) including reconstruction of Gatehouse for part servicing, public staircase and offices within (25,166sqm) and flexible use of parts of basement, lower ground, lower ground mezzanine and ground floor for either Class A1, Class A3, Class A4 or A5 purposes (1,287sqm) or any combination thereof. Car parking at basement and lower ground floor levels, Ancillary plant and servicing areas. Total floorspace proposed (29,285sqm).

candidates.title: LDD completion record: Byron Court Primary School, Spencer Road
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive records Byron Court Primary School, Spencer Road in Brent as Completed on 2019-03-29. The row records 3218 sqm proposed floorspace; 1.83 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Demolition of eight existing buildings on site comprising 4x teaching blocks, 1x shelter, 1x shed, 1x storage/garage and 1x kitchen and dining facilities and construction of new part single and part two storey building (to accommodate expansion of the school from 3 form to 5 form entry primary school), all-weather MUGA to include the reconfiguration of the School's playing field and associated landscaping and parking, upgrading of the Nathans Road access and temporary permission for the erection of a single teaching block (2x classrooms) for use until July 2017.
